sources: Detailed CEN 04/2026 (application and fee rules: ₹500 with ₹400 refunded after appearing in CBT 1, ₹250 for SC, ST, ex-servicemen, PwBD, female, transgender, minority and EBC candidates fully refunded after appearing; one RRB and one common application per candidate; account details cannot be changed after creation): https://rrb.indianrailways.gov.in/-/image/1787058904504CEN_04_2026_JE_DMS_English.pdf/examsDocuments
Objection-fee and e-call-letter timings per official RRB notices for CEN 05/2025 on rrb.indianrailways.gov.in

admitCard.where: Links on the official RRB websites (rrb.indianrailways.gov.in). The centre, date and shift on the e-call letter are final; change requests are not entertained.
admitCard.when: Exam city and date link about 10 days before the CBT; e-call letter download from about 4 days before
steps: Open your RRB's official website and open the exam city and date link about 10 days before the CBT. SC/ST candidates also see their free travel authority here.
Download the e-call letter from about 4 days before the exam and print it clearly.
Check your name, centre, date and shift. These are final, so contact the RRB at once if something is wrong.
Keep your Aadhaar updated and unlocked in the UIDAI system, because Aadhaar-linked biometric authentication is done at the centre.
carry: Your original Aadhaar card, or an e-verified printout of it, for the biometric check at the centre
admitCard.note: No phones, watches, calculators, bags or food are allowed inside; pens are provided.

answerKey.summary: After each CBT the RRBs open a window to view your questions, responses and the provisional answer keys, and to raise objections online. For CEN 05/2025 the CBT 1 window ran from 5 March 2026, 4 pm to 11 March 2026, 11:59 pm.
steps: Log in on your RRB's website with your application credentials when the answer key link opens.
Compare your responses with the provisional answer key, question by question.
Raise objections online and pay the fee per question before the window closes.
The RRBs' decision on objections is final. Watch your RRB website and registered email/SMS for the exact dates of your cycle.
answerKey.fee: ₹50 plus bank charges per question, refunded to the paying account if the objection is found correct.

result.summary: The CBT 1 result is announced RRB-wise as a normalised-score cutoff for CBT 2 shortlisting. The final shortlist for document verification is built only from CBT 2 marks, expressed as a Merit Index between 350 and 900 so that different branches compete on one scale.

stages.what: Common screening paper of 100 questions in 90 minutes with 1/3 negative marking (Mathematics 30, General Intelligence and Reasoning 25, General Awareness 15, General Science 30). Shortlists for CBT 2 at 15 times the community-wise vacancies of the RRB. Minimum qualifying: UR/EWS 40%, OBC-NCL and SC 30%, ST 25%. CEN 04/2026 CBT 1: 27 and 28 October 2026 (revised schedule).

150 questions in 120 minutes with 1/3 negative marking; a virtual calculator is provided on screen. General Awareness 15, Physics and Chemistry 15, Basics of Computers and Applications 10, Basics of Environment and Pollution Control 10, Technical Abilities 100 from your Exam Group. Same minimum qualifying percentages as CBT 1.

Candidates are shortlisted at 1:1 of the vacancies on normalised CBT 2 merit and post options; ties are broken by age (older first) and then alphabetically by given name. Before DV, photo and signature scans are uploaded on the orims-ir.gov.in/rbdv portal where the RRB asks for it. Original certificates checked at DV include Class 10 for date of birth, diploma/degree or B.Sc with marksheets, category certificates in the central format, EBC/BPL/Izzat MST documents if claimed, ex-servicemen and PwBD certificates, and an NOC from serving government or PSU employees.

Railway medical against the standard of the allotted post (most JE posts B-1 or B-2, some design posts A-3, CMA B-1). A-3 posts require colour, binocular, night and mesopic vision tests, and LASIK or similar refractive surgery makes candidates ineligible for them. A one-time medical appeal with prescribed charges is allowed under the laid-down conditions.

result.scorecard: Marks and cutoffs are published RRB-wise on the official RRB websites; candidates log in with their registration number and date of birth to view their score.
